<file name="fix-wps-python-parse.patch">
<details>
This is a patch file that updates Python 2 to Python 3 compatibility in WPS Office's `/usr/bin/wps` launcher script. It replaces deprecated Python 2 idioms (`print` statement, `urllib.unquote`) with their Python 3 equivalents (`print(...)` function, `urllib.parse.unquote`). This is a routine compatibility fix with no network activity, obfuscation, data exfiltration, or system modification beyond the intended urllib API update. It serves the application's stated purpose of properly decoding `file://` URLs.
